style: photorealistic editorial interior photography, near-monochrome warm neutral palette (warm black, stone grey, off-white, pale sage), soft natural daylight, matte surfaces, calm and quiet, no people, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark

images.purpose: 首屏 hero 背景；手機直式裁切後仍要有主體；左下方會疊白色大標，上三分之一保持乾淨暗色天花或牆面
images.prompt:
Quiet open kitchen seen from the dining table at dusk
Subject: a long continuous matte stone counter floating on a slim dark steel frame, one bowl and a wooden board on it
Details: honed grey stone with faint recycled-aggregate speckle, brushed stainless frame legs, dark warm wall behind, a single warm pendant light off, window light raking from the left
Constraints: the upper third is a plain dark wall with no objects, no people, no chairs in foreground
Intent: brand concept page hero, cinematic stillness

images.purpose: 「起點」段：廚房與餐桌是一個整體；全幅橫圖，不疊字
images.prompt:
Wide shot across a dining table toward an open kitchen counter in the same room
Subject: a long oak dining table meeting the end of a stone kitchen island at the same height, two ceramic cups and a linen cloth on the table
Details: morning daylight from a tall window, matte plaster walls in warm off-white, pale sage ceramic, soft shadows
Constraints: no people, no text, nothing on the walls
Intent: convey hospitality and the kitchen opening toward the table

images.purpose: 「第零點」段：檯面與桶身分離；深色段落用圖，顯示石面架在鋼骨上、桶身懸在下方留出空隙
images.prompt:
Close three-quarter view of a kitchen counter construction detail
Subject: a thick honed grey stone slab resting on a slender brushed stainless steel frame, with a separate matte dark cabinet box hanging beneath it leaving a visible open gap between slab and cabinet
Details: raking side light showing the stone edge grain, precise steel joints, the gap in shadow, concrete floor
Constraints: no people, no text, no appliances, plain dark background
Intent: explain the separation of worktop and cabinet as a structural idea

images.purpose: 「材料分區」段：三種材料並置的質感特寫，方形，不疊字
images.prompt:
Top-down macro still life of three material samples laid edge to edge
Subject: a honed grey recycled-aggregate stone tile, a brushed stainless steel plate, and a pale oak veneer board
Details: even soft light, visible stone speckle, fine brushing on the steel, straight wood grain, tiny real imperfections
Constraints: no text, no labels, no hands, neutral off-white background
Intent: material honesty, face / bone / body

images.purpose: 「開口向餐桌」段：從灶前看出去，看得見餐桌與座位；橫圖，不疊字
images.prompt:
View from behind the cooktop looking across the kitchen counter toward a dining table with chairs, as the cook would see it
Subject: the near counter edge in soft focus, the dining table and four chairs in focus beyond, a window at the far end
Details: evening light, matte dark cabinetry, stone counter, oak table, plates set but no food
Constraints: no people, no text, no clutter
Intent: the cook can see family and guests; the island faces people
